article.headline: Lee’s 21 lead James Madison over Towson 70-52
article.description: — Brandon Lee scored 21 points as James Madison beat Towson 70-52 on Wednesday.
article.linkText: Lee’s 21 lead James Madison over Towson 70-52
article.story: TOWSON, Md. -- — Brandon Lee scored 21 points as James Madison beat Towson 70-52 on Wednesday. Lee shot 6 of 11 from the field, including 2 for 5 from 3-point range, and went 7 for 7 from the line for the Dukes (3-2). Preston Fowler scored 12 points and added five rebounds. Adrian Myers shot 3 of 8 from the field and 5 for 6 from the line to finish with 11 points. Zion Stanford finished with 17 points and seven rebounds for the Tigers (3-3). Jaquan Womack added 11 points for Towson. Jon Barton also had nine points and three steals. James Madison carried a slim three-point lead into halftime, as Garrett Sundra led the way with seven points. James Madison outscored Towson by 15 points in the second half, and Lee scored a team-high 16 points in the second half to help their team secure the victory. Up next James Madison’s next game is Saturday against Virginia-Lynchburg at home, and Towson visits American on Sunday. ------ The Associated Press created this story using technology provided by Data Skrive and data from Sportradar.
